about: The shared words and small rules of "Quiz me on a YouTube video" (docs/STUDY-FROM-TEXT-DESIGN.md section 14, JARVIS-API section 112), word for word, plus sample replies of the frozen shapes. Written by tools/gen_youtube_cases.py: both apps' tests read this file.

failures.age_restricted: This video is age-restricted. Jarvis does not sign in to YouTube, so it cannot read its captions.
failures.fetch_timeout: YouTube took too long to answer. Nothing was changed - try again later.
failures.library_missing: Your PC's Jarvis does not have the caption reader installed yet - run apply-patches.ps1 on the PC.
failures.model_unavailable: The model on this PC did not answer. Nothing was changed - try again in a moment.
failures.no_captions: No captions for this video. The person who posted it may have turned them off, or there are none.
failures.no_captions_language: This video has no captions in that language.
failures.quiz_failed: The captions were read, but a quiz could not be made from them.
failures.too_little_text: The captions are too short to make a quiz from.
failures.video_unavailable: YouTube says this video is not available. It may be private, removed, or blocked where you are.
failures.youtube_failed: Could not read the captions from YouTube. It may have changed how it works. Nothing was changed.
failures.youtube_refused: YouTube refused the request. It sometimes blocks programs like this one - try again later. Nothing was changed.

already_started.message: It is already reading the captions and can no longer be cancelled.

bad_language.message: The caption language must be a short code such as en or es.

bad_link.message: That does not look like a link. Paste the video's address, which starts with https.

card_unavailable.message: Jarvis could not raise the approval card. Nothing was fetched.

link_has_login.message: That link has a name or password in it, so Jarvis will not use it. Paste the plain video address.

no_video.message: That link does not point to one video. Paste a video's own address.

not_a_web_link.message: That is not a web link. A YouTube address starts with https.

not_found.message: That YouTube request is not open any more. Start a new one.

not_youtube.message: That is not a YouTube video link. Jarvis only reads captions from youtube.com or youtu.be.

outside_text_turn.message: Jarvis has just read outside text or private things in this conversation, so it will not fetch a video's captions now. Start from the Quiz page.

playlist_link.message: That link is a playlist. Paste the link to one video.

request_waiting.message: A YouTube card is already waiting. Answer it first.

tier_not_ask.message: This needs your yes every time, but the settings file says otherwise, so it is switched off.

too_many_quizzes.message: Three quizzes are already open. Finish or stop one first.

request.message: You said no, so nothing was fetched.

expect.shown: You said no, so nothing was fetched.

request.message: No captions for this video. The person who posted it may have turned them off, or there are none.

expect.shown: No captions for this video. The person who posted it may have turned them off, or there are none.

body.intro: Paste a YouTube link and Jarvis reads the video's captions (the words shown as subtitles), then quizzes you on them. It asks with a card first, every time.

latest.message: Waiting for your yes on the approval card.

body.outside: The captions are treated as outside text: Jarvis never learns facts from them. Your answers are marked by the model on this PC.
body.terms: This breaks YouTube's terms and may be blocked. Only the caption text is fetched - never the video or its sound. The link tells YouTube which video you are studying.
body.title: Quiz me on a YouTube video
